_doc: PRESET: medium-length presentation / talk, full edit (longform.py). Keeps natural pacing (long pauses are shortened, not removed), subtitle-style captions, speaker lower third, chapter tags + chapters.txt for YouTube, an optional slides/screen feed with the speaker as an inset, intro title and end card. 'at_src' = SOURCE seconds (the studio fills them from the transcript), 'at'/'dur' = EDITED seconds. Keys starting with _ are notes.
name: presentation

output._doc: aspect 9:16 | 16:9 | 1:1 | 4:5 (or size [w, h]). focus = [x, y] fractions of the frame to keep in view (the speaker on a wide stage shot). zoom > 1 crops in. rotate = degrees to level the horizon (corners are zoomed out of view).

grade._doc: Project colour, applied to every clip without its own grade. exposure in EV stops, contrast and saturation 1 = unchanged, temperature and tint -1..1 (warm/cool, magenta/green), denoise 0..1 = video grain reduction (export only, check with Stills). The studio preview uses the same maths for colour.

export._doc: Export settings. short_side 540 | 720 | 1080 | 1440 | 2160 px; fps 24 | 25 | 30 | 50 | 60; quality high | standard | small; codec h264 (plays anywhere) | h265 (smaller); max_mbps caps the bitrate (venue players); audio_kbps; loudness in LUFS (null = leave as recorded); file = name in exports/ (default: the project name).

clip._doc: Source range to use: trim the setup before the talk and the applause after it.

trim._doc: mode: words keeps speech and shortens pauses longer than max_gap to lead + tail of air. head_tail = only cut before the first and after the last word. none = keep everything (still applies cuts).

_clips_doc: Optional "clips": the timeline, once edited in the studio: [{in, out, transition: {type, dur}, zoom, focus, rotate, grade}] in source seconds, any order. Without it the clips come from the transcript (trim, cuts, fillers). Transitions: fade, dip_black, dip_white, wipe_left, wipe_right, slide_left, slide_up, zoom, circle.
_cuts_doc: [start, end] SOURCE ranges to remove: false starts, technical breaks, off-topic tangents.

captions._doc: mode: lines (subtitles on a dark box) | words | off.

intro._doc: Title over the first seconds. Remove the title to skip.
intro.title: Talk title
intro.subtitle: Speaker Name | Event, Date

_chapters_doc: {at_src, title}. Each shows a small top-left tag (chapter_cards) and becomes a line in exports/<name>.chapters.txt; the first is pinned to 0:00 for YouTube.
_texts_doc: Free text overlays: {text, at | at_src, dur, x, y (centre, fractions), size (fraction of height), font display | sans | mono, color white | cyan | magenta | black, box 0..1 (dark box opacity), anim_in none | fade | slide_up | slide_left | pop | type, anim_out none | fade | slide_down | slide_right | pop, anim_dur}. Graphics (lower thirds, cards, chapters, intro) also take anim: fade | slide_right | slide_left | slide_up | none.
_screen_doc: Optional slides / screen recording: {"video": "raw/slides.mp4", "offset": 0.0, "default": "speaker", "layouts": [{"at_src": 30.0, "layout": "screen"}, {"at_src": 300.0, "layout": "speaker"}]}. offset = screen time minus camera time for the same moment. layout screen = slides full frame + speaker inset top-right.

audio._doc: source: video (camera mic) | screen (e.g. desk feed recorded with the slides). denoise and voice: off | light | medium | strong. denoise = high-pass for rumble + FFT noise reduction against the measured room noise; voice = less boom at 220 Hz, more presence at 3.2 kHz, de-essing. Applied to the whole recording before it is cut; the studio's Sound > Listen plays 10 s before/after.

music._doc: start = seconds to skip into the track. The studio finds its beats to snap cuts and text to the music.
